question: Where’s the closest gallery encountered when moving toward Anything for Princess!, Sewaren, NJ from Hellsgate Farms, Astoria, NY?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Hellsgate Farms%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Astoria%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NY%' LIMIT 1 ), end_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Anything for Princess%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Sewaren%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NJ%' LIMIT 1 ), target_azimuth_calc AS ( SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(s.geometry, e.geometry)) AS target_azimuth, s.geometry AS start_geom FROM start_point s, end_point e WHERE s.geometry IS NOT NULL AND e.geometry IS NOT NULL ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois AS p, target_azimuth_calc AS tac WHERE p.tourism = 'gallery' AND ( SELECT least( abs(tac.target_azimuth - degrees(ST_Azimuth(tac.start_geom, p.geometry))), 360 - abs(tac.target_azimuth - degrees(ST_Azimuth(tac.start_geom, p.geometry))) ) ) <= 45 -- Filter for galleries within +/- 45 degrees of the target direction ORDER BY ST_Distance(tac.start_geom::geography, p.geometry::geography) ASC LIMIT 1;
